name: tinyctx
description: Local-first routing proxy for Codex CLI: redirect compaction summaries to a local 27B model, scrub encrypted_content on cross-model swaps, escalate to GPT-5.5 only when needed.
author: tinyctx
post_install: echo 'tinyctx installed. Start the proxy with: ~/.tinyctx/scripts/start.sh'
echo 'Then run codex with: codex --profile tinyctx'
